The '''Devastation of Froz''' occurred during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. [[Naomi Dargon]], the imperial [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] of the [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]], ordered an [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] for the [[Frozian/Legends|Frozians']] support of the Rebel Alliance.<ref name="SoF" />
